<USER_REQUEST>
  Configure REAL Google Drive API integration for the existing
Tamil Nadu Environmental Monitoring project.

IMPORTANT:
The application already successfully authenticates to Google Earth Engine
using Application Default Credentials for:

monitoring-system-506515

GEE authentication is working.

However, GEE authentication alone MUST NOT be assumed to provide
Google Drive access.

I need the application to access MY Google Drive for the real
Earth Engine export → Drive → GeoTIFF pipeline.

DO NOT use fake Drive files.
DO NOT simulate Drive responses.
DO NOT hardcode a fake driveFileId.

==================================================
1. INSPECT CURRENT AUTHENTICATION
==================================================

Inspect the existing:

- Google authentication implementation
- ADC configuration
- GeeClientService
- GEE export implementation
- environment variables
- Google Cloud project configuration

Determine exactly which credentials are currently being used.

Do not replace working GEE authentication unnecessarily.

==================================================
2. GOOGLE DRIVE API
==================================================

Implement the official Google Drive API integration.

Enable/use:

Google Drive API

Use appropriate OAuth/ADC credentials.

The application must explicitly request the required Drive scope.

For development, support the existing local ADC approach where
appropriate.

Do not expose credentials or access tokens in logs.

==================================================
3. VERIFY AUTHENTICATED DRIVE ACCOUNT
==================================================

Create a diagnostic command such as:

npm run diagnose:drive

It must make a REAL Google Drive API request.

The diagnostic should report:

[DRIVE]
Authentication: SUCCESS

[DRIVE]
Authenticated Drive access: SUCCESS

[DRIVE]
Account/file visibility: SUCCESS

Do not print access tokens.

If authentication fails, print the exact reason.

==================================================
4. IMPORTANT DISTINCTION
==================================================

Do NOT assume:

GEE authentication SUCCESS
=
Drive authentication SUCCESS

They are separate API permissions.

The diagnostic must independently verify Drive access.

==================================================
5. REAL GEE EXPORT
==================================================

After Drive access is verified, connect the existing real GEE export
pipeline to Google Drive.

Use the actual selected GEE image:

COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED/20200109T051201_20200109T051844_T43PHM

and the actual Sathiyar zone geometry.

Create a REAL Earth Engine export whose destination is Google Drive.

Do not fabricate:

- export task ID
- Drive file ID
- file size
- completion status

==================================================
6. VERIFY THE REAL FILE
==================================================

After the GEE export actually completes:

search Google Drive for the actual exported file.

Verify:

- file exists
- file ID is real
- file size > 0
- file is the expected export
- file can be downloaded

Persist:

driveFileId
driveFileName
driveFileSizeBytes

Only after these checks should the application continue to
GeoTIFF processing.

==================================================
7. DRIVE PERMISSION FAILURE
==================================================

If Drive access is unavailable, return an explicit error such as:

DRIVE_AUTH_FAILED

If authentication succeeds but the exported file cannot be found:

DRIVE_FILE_MISSING

Never convert these failures into:

SUCCESS
or
BASELINE ACTIVE

==================================================
8. SECURITY
==================================================

Never:

- commit credentials
- commit OAuth client secrets
- print access tokens
- hardcode refresh tokens
- store credentials in MongoDB
- put credentials in frontend code

Keep Google credentials server-side only.

==================================================
9. FINAL DIAGNOSTIC
==================================================

Run:

npm run diagnose:gee
npm run diagnose:drive

Expected:

GEE:
Authentication SUCCESS
Real image discovery SUCCESS

DRIVE:
Authentication SUCCESS
Drive API access SUCCESS

Then perform the real:

GEE
→ Export
→ Drive
→ Download
→ GeoTIFF

pipeline.

FINAL RULE:

Do not claim Google Drive integration works until the application
has actually listed/accessed the authenticated Drive and has found
a real exported file.
</USER_REQUEST>
